# NDDev brand

- `mark.svg`: the owner's NDDev mark (three polygons), drawn in the direction's colour. It is never redrawn, traced or replaced by a lettering.
- `icons/<direction>.svg`: the favicon and direction icon, one style for every direction: a square tile with rounded corners, light by default (the main theme) and dark under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, the mark in the direction's seed where it holds 3:1 on the tile (WCAG 1.4.11), otherwise that theme's `accent.heading`.
- `icons/<direction>-light.svg`, `icons/<direction>-dark.svg`: the two fixed versions; touch icons, the ICO and preview cards are drawn from the light one.
- `brand.json`: the seeds, both icon styles and the rasters products draw from the light icon (192 and 180 px icons, a 16/32/48 px ICO, a 1200×630 card with the mark at 300 px).

Native packages carry the mark as geometry (`NDBrand.mark`).

Consume a release: copy this directory from the tag `vX.Y.Z` into the product and record the tag and the directory digest (docs/adr/0001-architecture.md §13). Never edit the copy; update it from a newer tag.
